newsitem.title: SPAIN: Fourth Spanish priest said killed in Zaire.
newsitem.headline: Fourth Spanish priest said killed in Zaire.

text.p: A fourth Spanish priest has been killed in Zaire, the leader of the missionary's religious order in Madrid said on Tuesday.
The Spanish Foreign Ministry could not immediately confirm the report. The ministry confirmed at the weekend the killings of three other Spanish priests in Zaire.

Adolfo Varas, leader of the Marist religious order in Madrid, said a fourth priest from his congregation had been killed in the area of Bukavu. The order said the four had been killed on October 31 by Hutu militiamen who were allied with the former Rwandan regime.
The foreign ministry said it did not know the exact location of the priests' bodies but one of Spain's ambassadors in central Africa was trying to recover their remains.
